anomalies.message: CPU load average is high across all intervals, indicating potential performance bottlenecks.
AI system has not generated any opportunities or made adjustments, which could indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review AI system configurations and logs to ensure it is functioning correctly and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and market conditions to ensure the platform is actively engaging in profitable trades.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.
